fields.notes: IHI 0022E is a wire-level / cycle-level bus protocol spec. It defines logical signal semantics and timing rules relative to ACLK only - no PDK-specific SDC, no floorplan / placement constraints, no clock-tree budget. ACE adds three snoop channels (AC/CR/CD) following the same single-clock rule; timing budgets for AC/CR/CD must be planned at integration.

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
